description: This file defines a Java interface 'FeatureDefinitionBuilder' that provides a fluent API for building an immutable 'FeatureDefinition'. It includes methods for adding, removing, and retrieving identifiers, as well as constructing the final 'FeatureDefinition' instance.

classes.name: FeatureDefinitionBuilder
classes.description: A mutable builder for creating an immutable FeatureDefinition with a fluent API, supporting addition, removal, and retrieval of identifiers.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a specified identifier to the builder if it is not already present, supporting method chaining.

methods.name: addAll
methods.description: Adds all identifiers from an Iterable to the builder, supporting method chaining.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specified identifier from the builder if present, supporting method chaining.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Removes all identifiers found in an Iterable from the builder, supporting method chaining.

methods.name: getFirstIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves the first identifier in the builder, or null if none are present.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of identifiers currently in the builder; guaranteed to be at least one.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Returns a Stream of the identifiers in the builder.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns an immutable FeatureDefinition containing the identifiers accumulated so far.
